hotspots.title: Hungarian Orban Ex-Minister Buried Cash Corruption Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Opposition leader Péter Magyar and Tisza Party lawmakers have escalated demands for government resignations following revelations of billions in illicit cash uncovered in graft investigations linked to former minister Miklós Seszták. The scandal has triggered fierce shouting matches in parliament, death and bomb threats targeting political figures, and polling data showing Tisza surging past Fidesz.
hotspots.affect: Commands white-hot affective focus due to outrage framing around buried corruption money, death threats, parliamentary chaos, and existential panic within the ruling party.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal has intensified campaign messaging ahead of the November 29 snap election, promoting hardline proposals including border militarization, strict school quotas, and the expulsion of illegal immigrants. The campaign features aggressive identity rhetoric and clashes at public rallies as polling indicates a tight race for a conservative majority.
hotspots.affect: Drives high affective engagement through emergency framing over national identity, anti-immigrant grievance, and high-stakes electoral contention.

hotspots.title: Macron-Le Pen Clash Over Ukraine Aid & 2027
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen confirmed directly to Ukraine's ambassador in Paris that a Rassemblement National administration would halt all future financial assistance to Kyiv. The stance drew sharp criticism from Macron allies and government ministers, who accuse Le Pen of threatening European security and misleading voters ahead of the 2027 presidential race.
hotspots.affect: Commands heavy attention through stark foreign policy polarization, high-stakes diplomatic confrontation, and domestic political combat.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Ratifies 2027 Reelection Bid
hotspots.blurb: President Javier Milei and key cabinet officials are aggressively advancing political reforms to suspend the PASO primary elections while consolidating alliance structures for 2027. The push comes amid internal tension between Security Minister Patricia Bullrich and Karina Milei, alongside ongoing legal battles over the $LIBRA case.
hotspots.affect: Sustains high heat due to institutional power plays, triumphalist executive framing, and fierce opposition pushback against electoral rule changes.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: Alternative für Deutschland's decision to nominate former 1990 World Cup champion Thomas Berthold for Federal President has sparked severe condemnation from the German Football Association (DFB) and mainstream political parties. The nomination, alongside church backlash over AfD-themed chocolate Santa promotional items, has ignited fresh debate over party normalization.
hotspots.affect: Generates strong moral friction and institutional outrage by dragging prominent cultural and sports figures into partisan far-right contention.
